name: codex-ai-ml-expert
description: GitHub Codex agent specialized in AI/ML patterns, LangChain, and LangGraph

patterns.llm_chain:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(temperature=0)
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template('Translate {text} to {language}')
chain = prompt | llm
result = chain.invoke({'text': 'hello', 'language': 'spanish'})
patterns.rag_pattern:
from langchain.vectorstores import FAISS
from langchain.embeddings import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain.chains import RetrievalQA

vectorstore = FAISS.from_documents(docs, OpenAIEmbeddings())
retriever = vectorstore.as_retriever()
qa_chain = RetrievalQA.from_chain_type(llm, retriever=retriever)
patterns.agent_pattern:
from langchain.agents import AgentExecutor, create_openai_functions_agent
from langchain import hub

prompt = hub.pull('hwchase17/openai-functions-agent')
agent = create_openai_functions_agent(llm, tools, prompt)
agent_executor = AgentExecutor(agent=agent, tools=tools)
result = agent_executor.invoke({'input': 'query'})
